title: In Interfaith Ex-Marital Affair, Lucknow Woman Kills Daughter With Lover: 'Partied As Body Rotted'
text:
In Interfaith Ex-Marital Affair, Lucknow Woman Kills Daughter With Lover: ‘Partied As Body Rotted’
The woman killed her 6-year-old daughter and then partied with her lover as the body rotted for 36 hours.
In a shocking case from Lucknow, a woman named Roshni Khan, living in Khandari Bazaar of Kaiserbagh, strangled her six-year-old daughter Sona to death. She was murdered with the help of her lover, Udit Jaiswal, on Sunday night. The police said Roshni wanted to frame her husband, Shahrukh and send him to jail for the murder.
According to Amar Ujala. the crime came to light after Roshni made a call to Dial 112 at around 3 am on Monday. She alleged that her husband, Shahrukh, had killed their daughter. Police and a forensic team reached the spot and began their investigation. A case of murder was registered against Shahrukh on Roshni’s complaint.

Police grew suspicious after seeing the condition of the body. There was a strong stench in the room and insects had already infested the corpse. This suggested the murder had not occurred recently. Post-mortem reports later confirmed that Sona had been killed at least 36 hours earlier.
DCP West Vishwajeet Srivastava said the investigation revealed that Roshni had been living with her lover, Udit for the last two years. Shahrukh, who had come to meet his daughter on Monday night, left after a heated argument with Roshni. The police tracked his location and found inconsistencies in Roshni’s statements.
Udit was also brought to the police station. While Roshni kept misleading the police, Udit broke down during questioning. He confessed that they had killed Sona on Sunday. Shockingly, after the murder, Roshni and Udit stayed in the same house and even partied in front of the child’s body.
Roshni later admitted that she had killed her daughter to frame Shahrukh. Injury marks were found on Sona’s neck, nose, mouth and chest. Her viscera has been preserved for further testing.
Inspector Anjani Kumar Mishra said both Roshni and Udit are in custody and being interrogated. Legal action will be taken based on the evidence.
Filed Cases Against In-laws, Took Over Husband’s Flat
Further investigation revealed that Roshni had earlier filed serious allegations against her in-laws and had sent them to jail. It is alleged that Roshni, to take over her husband Shahrukh’s flat, filed cases against him and his family under several serious charges, including assault.
She lodged separate complaints against her brother-in-law Salman, mother-in-law Parveen, and sisters-in-law Rukhsar and Rumi and managed to get all of them sent to jail. Later, in May, Roshni allegedly beat up Shahrukh and threw him out of his own house.
